The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] more commonly known as [[Voidhound|Ace]] owned an '''[[XS stock light freighter/Legends|XS stock light freighter]]''' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Having owned it for a while already, the smuggler had the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] stolen by the criminal [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]]. Ace followed Skavak to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where [[Gender/Legends|he]] had taken the vessel, and eventually retrieved it.

During Ace's search for [[Nok Drayen]]'s lost fortune, the starship was modified several times. It had its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and [[Engine/Legends|engine]] replaced and a new [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] was installed.
